Vintage tobacco smoking pipe with a bent-stem design and bulbous bowl made of light brown wood, likely briar. The bowl and shank feature ornate embossed brass or gold-tone metal banding with scrollwork and floral motifs. The black stem is curved with a bit end, possibly made of vulcanite or horn. The pipe shows signs of age and use including wear on the finish, darkened areas inside the bowl rim, and residue or wear marks on the metal band and stem joint area.
